problem: The prescribedAnalyticalProcedure constraint applies to every calculation case linked from every ship, but I2.17.1 applies only where the case concerns shell plating or local-frame requirements governed by I2.4, I2.6, or I2.7. The candidate has no applicability condition identifying that scope, so it can reject calculation methods outside the requirement's scope.
required_change: Make the nltl:calculationMethod prescribedAnalyticalProcedure constraint conditional on the assessed hull structure being the applicable shell-plating or local-frame structure governed by I2.4, I2.6, or I2.7, rather than enforcing it for all calculation cases.
regression_guard: Preserve the ship-to-calculation-case and calculation-case-to-assessed-hull-structure paths while retaining the prohibition only within the explicitly applicable shell-plating/local-frame scope.
